## About Me

**Born and raised in Cleveland, Ohio**,my passion for biological science led me to Kent State University for my undergraduate studies. Over the next 10 years, I called Nashville, TN home, working in both clinical oncology and academic cancer research. Driven to expand my technical and analytical scope, I returned home to Cleveland to pursue my Master’s degree in Biomedical and Health Informatics at Case Western Reserve University. Alongside my studies, I work full-time as a Research Assistant IV, focusing on single-cell workflows and HIV genomics.
